evidence.observation: Reflux collapsed to ~0.005 L/h at k=9-13 while distillate spiked to 0.6-0.77 L/h; flows erratic thereafter (FT704 1.08 at k=20)
Went negative (-1.29, -0.61) then swung to 3.9 mbar, inconsistent with steady packing load
Ratio readout stays ~3.6-4.9 while measured reflux/distillate ratio changes drastically, suggesting ratio channel not tracking actual flows
Upper column temperatures drifting down ~1.5 °C as reflux is lost, top section cooling
Reboiler reads ~415-420 °C, implausible for this system and rising monotonically — possible thermocouple fault

args.missing_evidence: Reflux pump/valve status and a check of FT703 against condenser duty, plus T701 thermocouple verification; a distillate composition (GC) sample to test whether separation was maintained.
